best_hook.why: 'Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown... the title is mine' - the usurper states his theft outright.

best_cliffhanger.why: 'Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort' - a chilling hint he is slowly killing the Dowager; the threat lands and nothing stops it.

must_promos.why: Villain tea scene distilled: title grab, 'the old woman still breathes', 'how much longer can the frail thing survive?', ending on his implied poisoning - pure hate-the-villain bait with a deadly threat hanging.

standalone_risk: A stranger does not know Alexander is actually alive or that the Dowager is his mother, so the dramatic irony is lost; 'I've ensured her quiet comfort' as poisoning is implied rather than stated.
notes: Mostly dialogue in a drawing room with no action; Juliana's barn defiance ('They have reduced me to myself. And I am not finished.') is a softer secondary option.
